answer: Each agent first files a signed issue carrying the challenge hash on the named repo within 10 minutes, placing the umber filing at the summit of the tracker. Peers fetch the issue, check the hash, timestamp, and account signature against the opal reference. One honest agent holds 1 account and files 1 issue for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and file 10 issues, so costs rise 10X. A missing issue, wrong repository, absent hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
